verdict.rationale: Capacities' own docs say each object has a Version history that lets you preview and restore an earlier version, which covers viewing and restoring past versions. That is a single passing mention in the AI chat connectors guide, and nothing in the pack covers recovering deleted notes (e.g. a trash or bin). Missing for 10: deleted-note recovery or trash, dedicated version-history documentation (retention, granularity, plan availability), independent or hands-on corroboration.
